import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleOpenLocusFlat
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.WholeFiberOpen

/-!
# Whole-fibre invertibility on the base

For a universally closed morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, the largest base open over
which a module `M` is invertible is the complement of the image of its
noninvertibility locus. We construct this open and prove that its universal
base change carries an invertible module.

This is the proper-image step of Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*, Section 3,
`th:repDiv`. It does not supply relative flatness of a quotient with kernel
`M`, or a flattening stratum for arbitrary base changes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X S T : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The base open over which `M` is invertible on the entire total space. -/
noncomputable def wholeFiberLineBundleOpen (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (M : X.Modules) : S.Opens := wholeFiberOpen f (lineBundleOpen M)

/-- A morphism landing in the whole-fibre invertibility open pulls the
module back to an invertible sheaf on its entire base-changed total space. -/
theorem isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen
    (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] (M : X.Modules) (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hg : Set.range g ⊆ wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M) :=
  isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen M _
    ((range_subset_wholeFiberOpen_iff f g (lineBundleOpen M)).mp hg)

/-- The actual universal restriction over the constructed base open is
invertible, with no flatness or invertibility premise on `M`. -/
theorem wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_isLocallyTrivial
    (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] (M : X.Modules) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((pullback (pullback.fst f (wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M).ι)).obj M) := by
  apply isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen
  rw [Opens.range_ι]

/-- Maximality among all open subschemes of the base. -/
theorem le_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff
    (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] (M : X.Modules) (V : S.Opens) :
    V ≤ wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback (pullback.fst f V.ι)).obj M) := by
  constructor
  · intro hV
    apply isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen
    rwa [Opens.range_ι]
  · intro hV
    have h := (range_subset_wholeFiberOpen_iff f V.ι (lineBundleOpen M)).mpr
      (range_subset_lineBundleOpen_of_isLocallyTrivial_pullback M _ hV)
    rwa [Opens.range_ι] at h

/-- Open tests factor uniquely through the whole-fibre invertibility open
exactly when their pulled-back module is invertible. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
    (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] (M : X.Modules)
    (g : T ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ (wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M).toScheme,
      l ≫ (wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M).ι = g) ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M) := by
  change (∃! l : T ⟶ (wholeFiberOpen f (lineBundleOpen M)).toScheme,
    l ≫ (wholeFiberOpen f (lineBundleOpen M)).ι = g) ↔ _
  rw [existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberOpen_iff]
  exact ⟨isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen M _,
    range_subset_lineBundleOpen_of_isLocallyTrivial_pullback M _⟩

/-- Flat tests factor uniquely through the whole-fibre invertibility open
exactly when their pulled-back module is invertible. Flatness is essential
for reflection; relative flattening is needed to treat arbitrary tests. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff_of_flat
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] (g : T ⟶ S) [Flat g] :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ (wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M).toScheme,
      l ≫ (wholeFiberLineBundleOpen f M).ι = g) ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M) := by
  change (∃! l : T ⟶ (wholeFiberOpen f (lineBundleOpen M)).toScheme,
    l ≫ (wholeFiberOpen f (lineBundleOpen M)).ι = g) ↔ _
  rw [existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberOpen_iff]
  exact (isLocallyTrivial_flat_pullback_iff_range_subset_lineBundleOpen _ M).symm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
